# RustDesk MCP

Remote desktop management via MCP protocol. 16 tools for device status, peer connections, address book management, file transfers, screenshots, recording, resource monitoring, and Wake-on-LAN.

- [Full documentation](llms-full.txt)
- Port: 10804 (frontend), 10805 (backend)
- Transport: stdio + HTTP (dual)
- Framework: FastMCP 3.4+, FastAPI, Tauri 2.0 NSIS
